I'm sure someone wanted to know. Below is the code that you will be using:

div.sitetable.linklisting {
background-color: #ADD6FF;
border: solid 3px #1A4C80;
-webkit-border-radius: 10px;
-moz-border-radius: 10px;
border-radius: 10px;
display: inline-block;
}

To break down each piece I provide this image so you know what you are changing.

Do not change the display setting if you want it to look like my example.

Keep all border-radius fields the same number, though change the px count to whatever best suits your needs.

A great resource is w3's hex color picker. It is available here.

BONUS: If you want to break how your verse displays posts and instead have them all next to each other, change your css tag to read div.thing
